bug_info.bug_desc: In usbuart_core.sv, the output-enable signal cio_oe from usbdev_iomux is assigned to cio_usb_dp_o and cio_usb_dn_o, which are the USB data output ports. These ports are already driven by the usbdev_iomux instance outputs .cio_usb_dp_o and .cio_usb_dn_o, creating an illegal multi-driver conflict and preventing the module's actual output-enable ports cio_usb_dp_en_o and cio_usb_dn_en_o from being driven. The intended output enables are therefore not propagated to the chip I/O pads, while the data outputs are incorrectly forced to follow the enable signal.
bug_info.fix_hint: Drive the output-enable ports instead of the data output ports: assign cio_usb_dp_en_o = cio_oe and cio_usb_dn_en_o = cio_oe. This removes the conflicting driver on the data output ports and correctly forwards the USB transmit output-enable to the chip I/O enable signals.
